english.title: Provide air traffic control service otherwise than in accordance with appropriately maintained manual
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) provided an air traffic control service at **(..SPECIFY PLACE..) when

(A)_[the service was not provided in accordance with the standards and procedures specified in a manual of air traffic services for that place]_
(B)_[the manual of air traffic services for that place was not produced to the CAA within a reasonable time after a request for its production was made by the CAA]_
(C)_[such amendments or additions were not made to the manual as the CAA required]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 182 and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
provided an air traffic control service at a place when
the service was not provided in accordance with the standards and procedures specified in a manual of air traffic services for that place OR
the manual was not produced to the CAA within a reasonable time after a request for its production was made by the CAA OR
such amendments or additions were made to the manual as the CAA required
